title: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-FP8 on 2x H100 (TP=2), vLLM v0.28: no-router vs llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified, with and without 400 GiB CPU offload
description: Step 24. One vLLM pod (2 H100, GPU KV 2.24M tokens), AgentX replay of the Weka Claude Code trace, 60 min per point, fresh vLLM pod per point. CPU tier 400 GiB = 8.74M tokens. # thunder-agent gate as in thunder-pr3-plugins.yaml with the idle lease cut from
# 30 s to 10 s (step 24, 400 GiB CPU offload): a session idle 10 s after its last
# response can be paused for another session; with offloading its prefix is likely
# still in the CPU tier when it returns. The AgentX trace's gaps between turns:
# median about 1.7 s, p90 9 to 19 s, 7 to 9 percent over 30 s. Everything else,
# including the 1800 s forced admission, is unchanged.
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
featureGates:
- flowControl
plugins:
- type: agent-identity
  parameters:
    additionalSessionHeaders:
    - x-session-id
- type: thunder-agent
  name: thunder
  parameters:
    capacityTokens: 2237040
    utilThreshold: 1.0
    idleLeaseSeconds: 10
    headWaitStarvationMs: 1800000
    evictionTtlSeconds: 3600
- type: max-score-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
flowControl:
  defaultRequestTTL: "0s"
  saturationDetector:
    pluginRef: thunder
  defaultPriorityBand:
    fairnessPolicyRef: thunder
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: thunder
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
